system.boundary: Build a three-axis articulated hydraulic arm supplied by one finite-flow pressure source.
engineering_objects: P9-XFLUID01 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: joint_state, hydraulic_pressure, hydraulic_flow, actuation
physical_paths: The lift, reach, and bucket joints must be driven through independently metered valves and compressible hydraulic actuator states, while all three branches draw from the same pump; directly prescribing joint motion is not a valid implementation.
All signals must come from the causal hydraulic and mechanical paths rather than command copies or precomputed trajectories.
functional_paths: Across the declared range, closed-loop regulate all three actual joint angles, preserve pressure-flow-motion causality and the shared-pump flow limit, remain within the supplied pressure boundary, and recover after the temporary internal-leakage increase.
